title: UV Exposure Log Status Mix
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=uv:exposure
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(exposure_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the UV exposure log feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `exposure_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It builds the overall mood of your UV exposure log feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
